content: The recommended daily dose of soluble fiber for supplementation is 4 grams, equivalent to 2 teaspoons, taken orally three times a day (TID). This should be mixed with 4 to 8 ounces of liquid or soft food. For individuals aged 12 years and older, the dosage remains 4 grams (2 teaspoons) orally TID. For children aged 6 to 11 years, the recommended dose is 2 grams (1 teaspoon) orally TID. The soluble fiber powder should be added to 4 to 8 ounces of liquid or soft food before consumption. For geriatric patients, it is essential to evaluate their fluid intake adequacy prior to prescribing this supplement. Refer to adult dosing guidelines for further details. Gastrointestinal side effects may include bloating, flatulence, and general gastrointestinal discomfort. Hypersensitivity reactions to the product or its excipients may occur. Some formulations may contain phenylalanine, potassium, or sodium, which should be considered in patients with specific dietary restrictions or sensitivities. Exercise caution when prescribing to patients with esophageal strictures, ulcers, stenosis, intestinal adhesions, gastrointestinal obstruction, fecal impaction, or difficulty swallowing. Insufficient fluid intake while using this product may increase the risk of fecal impaction or bowel obstruction. Patients should consult a healthcare professional before use. In pregnancy, this product is generally considered safe. Controlled studies in pregnant women have not demonstrated any evidence of fetal risk.
